description:
Listed building consent for Underpinning
and Refurbishment works to include: 1)
Demolition – removal of existing concrete floor slab throughout the
building, removal of non-structural internal partitions and
alterations to existing structural internal partitions; removal of existing
windows and doors at rear extension; removal of kitchen and sanitaryware;
removal of heating system; removal of external paving and excavation of French
drains. 2) Proposed works - construction of external concrete
piles and needle beams; insulated solid concrete ground floor, to
include localised tanking in flat 6; construction of internal wall partitions,
including separating walls; installation of internal wall insulation
systems; installation of new windows and doors to the rear elevation; repairs
to existing windows and installation
of slim-line double glazing to front elevation; re-installation
of existing doors with upgraded high-security ironmongery in the front
elevation; installation of new gas-heating combi units and ventilation system,
to include slate roof vents; installation of new kitchen and
sanitaryware; installation of new electrics and power throughout the
building; construction of new gullies and French drains; installation of
new paved area to match the existing, to include the reinstallation of existing
paviours; like for like replacement of existing fence.
